app.name: Curset
app.tagline: Courses with exercises graded on the server.

exam.intro: The course's exams, each with its own rules: questions, time and scoring.
exam.conflictBody: Starting a new one abandons it. It will not be graded or saved.
exam.submitConfirm: Submit the exam? Answers are final.
exam.submitConfirmUnanswered: {{count}} question(s) still unanswered — they will be marked incorrect. Submit anyway?
exam.abandonConfirm: Abandon this exam? It will not be scored or saved.
exam.penalty: Each wrong answer takes off {{fraction}} of a right one
exam.partCases: {{title}}: one case to choose out of {{choose}}, {{count}} questions
exam.noPresets: This course has no exams yet.
exam.timeUp: Time is up. The exam is submitted with what you answered.
exam.reserveHint: Reserve questions only count if an earlier one is voided.
exam.chooseCase: Mark the case you want graded
exam.chooseCaseRule: It is graded only if you mark exactly one. With none or two marked, this part is not graded.
exam.notGradedSeveralCases: more than one case was marked
exam.notGradedPreviousPart: the previous part did not reach its minimum

auth.usernameInvalid: Username must be 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter the verified email of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If that address belongs to an account and is verified, a link is on its way. It works for 60 minutes.
auth.resetUnavailable: This server does not send email, so the password cannot be reset by email.
auth.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
auth.verifyDone: Email confirmed. You can now use it to reset your password.

account.title: Account
account.emailHint: Only used to reset your password. You sign in with your username.
account.emailNone: No email yet. Without one, a forgotten password cannot be recovered.
account.checkInbox: Open the link we sent to this address.
account.mailUnavailable: This server does not send email, so the address cannot be verified.

course.prereqFootnote: Prerequisites are advice, never a barrier — the whole course is open from day one, in any order.
course.markCompleteHint: This is the only thing Progress counts as "read" — we don't measure reading.
course.markCompleteConfirm: You haven't tried all the exercises in this lesson yet. Mark it complete anyway?
course.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be generated: {{reason}}
course.pdfHint: The whole course — theory, figures, exercises and an answer key — as one printable document.
course.pdfExerciseExcluded_one: {{count}} interactive exercise not included in this printed edition.
course.pdfExerciseExcluded_other: {{count}} interactive exercises not included in this printed edition.
course.pdfAnswerKeyIntro: One answer per printed exercise, numbered as it is on the page: 11.5 here is Exercise 11.5 in module M11. Chart answers quote the prices of the very chart printed with the question.
course.pdfOrderingHint: Put these in the right order.
course.pdfMatchingHint: Match each numbered item with one lettered option.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Every term the course defines, with the lesson that teaches it. The glossary refers; the lesson explains.
glossary.pdfIntro: Every term the course defines, in alphabetical order, each with the lesson that teaches it. The glossary refers; the lesson explains.
glossary.loadFailed: The glossary could not be loaded.

exercise.comingSoon: Interactive exercise — arrives in the next increment.
exercise.reorderHint: Use the arrows to put these in the right order.
exercise.matchHint: Tap an item, then tap its match below.
exercise.caseDone: You have answered every question of the case.
exercise.question: Question {{number}}

stats.intro: Honest information, not a reward: what you've read, what you've answered, and where you struggle. First-attempt accuracy is the number that's hard to fool.
stats.empty: Nothing yet. Read a lesson or do an exercise and your progress shows up here.
stats.coverage: {{published}} of {{total}} modules published — figures below are over published content only.
stats.readingNote: Only the lessons you mark yourself, at the end of each lesson, count here. We don't measure reading — no scroll tracking, no time tracking.
stats.smallSample: Under {{min}} data points we show the fraction, not the percentage: one data point would move the percentage by more than {{min}} points.
stats.costliestNeedsData: Not enough data to rank anything yet. A module appears here once you've answered at least {{min}} of its distinct exercises — below that, ranking you would mean ranking you on a single question.
stats.costliestLine: {{wrong}} of {{answers}} answers wrong · {{first}} right first time
stats.byModuleNote: The last two columns are counted over different populations, which is why the figures in one row need not agree with each other.
stats.globalHint: Anonymous, aggregated first-attempt accuracy across all learners — hardest modules first. The rate is over first attempts at distinct exercises; the figure after it is how many learners have tried the module, and a module only appears once at least {{min}} have.
stats.globalNeedsData: There are still too few of us for this to mean anything. A module appears here once at least {{min}} distinct learners have attempted it; below that the figure would describe one or two specific people rather than the course.

chartLabel.signal_cross: Signal-line cross only (MACD line stays one side of zero)
chartLabel.zero_cross: Zero-line cross (the MACD line crosses zero itself)
chartLabel.whipsaw: Whipsaw — repeated crosses in a range
chartLabel.cvd_confirms: No divergence — CVD confirms the move
chartLabel.open_space: Same form away from any level → noise
chartLabel.channel_failed: Channel failed (out through its own line)
chartLabel.pullback_against_trend: A pullback against the higher frame
chartLabel.continuation_with_trend: A continuation of the higher frame
chartLabel.higher_frame_ranges: Neither — the higher frame is ranging
